title: gravitas.instructor-flow/2
description: The flow of a lesson an instructor reads in the answer key, in js/data/instructorFlow.js: for each lesson id, a list of blocks, each from one step sid to another and the text for that run of steps. Version 1 named the run by step numbers (`steps`, such as "18-22"); js/instructorFlow.js readFlow() reads it by looking the numbers up in the lesson and drops, with a note, a block whose steps are not there. A record of a newer version is refused in words (readVersioned). FORMATS.md lists it.
